entities.name: Naya
entities.description: A plane of enormous gargantuans worshipped as gods by jungle-faring elves and leonin, built around the red-green-white 5-power theme.

entities.name: Esper
entities.description: A civilization infused with an arcane metal known as etherium, home of the telemins.

entities.name: Lorwyn
entities.description: A pastoral plane unsuited to a massive Hellion.

entities.name: Grixis
entities.description: A plane of Shards of Alara block whose black-blue-red mana would not welcome a platypus spell.

entities.name: Colfenor
entities.description: Rhys's old mentor, from whose seedcone a strange treefolk sapling grew.

entities.name: Rhys
entities.description: A character in the Lorwyn and Morningtide novels whose old mentor was Colfenor.

entities.name: Sapling of Colfenor
entities.description: A strange new treefolk sapling that grew from the seedcone of Colfenor.

entities.name: Telemins
entities.description: Esper 'mage dolls' who volunteer to be mind-controlled by virtuoso mind-mages.

entities.name: Nicol Bolas
entities.description: A Planeswalker said to have claimed that both birth and death are reversible.

entities.name: Planeswalkers
entities.description: Beings born with the spark who can travel between planes; only a tiny fraction of sentient beings have it.

entities.name: Spark
entities.description: The potential for planeswalking, which can be damaged or destroyed by terrible magics, mind injury or bodily death.

events.summary: The Eventide team asks Creative which legends should appear, and the Sapling of Colfenor is concepted from the Lorwyn and Morningtide novels.
events.quote: The card Sapling of Colfenor arose from the Lorwyn and Morningtide novels, in which a strange new treefolk sapling grew from the seedcone of Rhys's old mentor, Colfenor.

events.summary: Creative proposes the Esper telemins as a concept for Conflux, producing Telemin Performance.
events.quote: I told him a few, including the idea of the Esper telemins—"mage dolls" who volunteer to be mind-controlled by virtuoso mind-mages.

events.summary: The columnist argues an undead being with a spark might ignite it, but death may destroy the spark.
